description: Issue fields a correlation rule must not write through alert_fields. Read by tools/check_issue_field_targets.py. Field names are cliNames as GET /xsoar/public/v1/incidentfields lists them.

blocked.hostos: Core Alert Fields single-select with fixed values (AGENT_OS_*, NO_HOST). Mapping an event value into it left about half the issues in a burst with their playbook never started, on two tenants; removing the mapping started 123 of 123 on both.
blocked.action: Core Alert Fields single-select with about 40 fixed values. Same class of field as hostos.
blocked.sourcebrand: Platform field with fixed values, set by the platform for the alert's source. Same class of field as hostos.
blocked.dbotmirrordirection: Platform single-select with fixed values that controls mirroring.
blocked.runstatus: The playbook run state of the issue. The platform owns it.
blocked.playbookid: The playbook assigned to the issue. Automation rules set it.
blocked.investigationids: Platform link between the issue and its investigation.
blocked.type: The issue type, which decides layouts and automation rules.

warn.linkedcount: Platform system counter (type internal). Written by a shipped rule; not proven harmful, review before relying on it.
warn.tags: Platform system field. Written by shipped rules; not proven harmful.

allowed_system_fields.severity: Rule severity is meant to be set by the rule.
